[04] FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a free trial?
Yes. Every new team gets 5 free test runs so you can try TesterArmy end-to-end before upgrading.
What counts as a test run?
Each test run - whether triggered from chat, the CLI, a GitHub deployment, or a scheduled job - counts as one test run, up to 20 minutes of execution time.
What happens when I hit the limit?
New test runs are blocked until the next billing cycle. Upgrade your plan or contact us to increase your limit.
Do you support enterprise onboarding?
Yes. Book a call for custom limits, self-hosting, SSO, and dedicated support.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Cancel from your dashboard settings. Your subscription stays active until the end of the billing period.
Where can I see setup steps?
Follow the Project Setup guide for GitHub and Vercel integration.
